description: This header defines replacements for inline ARM Cortex-M CMSIS intrinsics, including no-op implementations for synchronization barriers and atomic operations, tailored for a POSIX simulation environment.

methods.name: __WFE
methods.description: Function declaration for Wait For Event.

methods.name: __WFI
methods.description: Function declaration for Wait For Interrupt.

methods.name: __STREXB
methods.description: Pretend to execute a STR Exclusive (8 bit) operation, always succeeds.

methods.name: __STREXH
methods.description: Pretend to execute a STR Exclusive (16 bit) operation, always succeeds.

methods.name: __STREXW
methods.description: Pretend to execute a STR Exclusive (32 bit) operation, always succeeds.

methods.name: __LDREXB
methods.description: Pretend to execute a LDR Exclusive (8 bit) operation, loads value from pointer.

methods.name: __LDREXH
methods.description: Pretend to execute a LDR Exclusive (16 bit) operation, loads value from pointer.

methods.name: __LDREXW
methods.description: Pretend to execute a LDR Exclusive (32 bit) operation, loads value from pointer.

methods.name: __CLREX
methods.description: Pretend to remove the exclusive lock, does nothing.

methods.name: __CLZ
methods.description: Model of ARM CLZ instruction, counts leading zeros in a 32-bit integer.
